choices.text: Yeah! We're going to have a blast playing hide-and-seek!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Alright, everybody! It's time to get ready!

choices.text: Did you come all the way to watch the competition, Yaoyao?

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Not exactly. Well, it was kind of a coincidence...

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Xiangling will be hosting a golden-haired lady wearing a big chef's hat who's visiting from afar, so she's busy preparing fresh and interesting dishes.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: While chatting with Yanfei, she suddenly realized she'd never tried mixing Liyue and Mondstadt cuisines before, so she decided to come to Mondstadt to look for some new recipes.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: But recently, Wanmin Restaurant has been super busy, so she couldn't come herself. That's why I'm tagging along with Yanfei, to go in her place.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Master said I should think of it as a little adventure for me, and that with Yanfei taking care of me, she doesn't have to worry at all.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: How's your journey going?

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: It was amazing! Besides picking up local recipes from the restaurants, I also visited the huge Knights of Favonius Library and borrowed some more advanced books on Mondstadt cooking theory.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: When we get back, I'll remind Xiangling to study them carefully. I'm sure she'll come up with amazing new dishes — the kind that'll make your jaw drop!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: But you know, it's not just about recipes and books. What's most precious is something you can't really put a value on.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Master always says, "Traveling the world and making lots of friends is one of life's greatest joys." This time, I got to meet Klee and Sayu, and it made me so happy!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Klee's bombs are so powerful! They're perfect when my spear isn't enough to handle lots of bad guys at once. And they're great for practicing dodging too, so you can really build up your basic skills!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Of course, for regular fighters, they can be a bit dangerous... But Klee understands that, and she always makes sure no one's nearby before using her bombs. She's really thoughtful!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: And Sayu's camouflage skills are so cool! I'd never seen techniques like that for hiding yourself before...

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: In Liyue's legends, martial artists who master these skills and move unseen often become silent heroes, striking against wrongdoers without a trace.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Next time I visit, I'd like to bring Qiqi along. I have a feeling the four of us would get along really well!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Absolutely! And what surprised me is that some flavors actually feel quite familiar, like the Northern Smoked Chicken — it has a comforting similarity to Liyue cuisine.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Oh, and I also found something interesting in one of the books I borrowed for Xiangling! It mentioned that Mondstadt used to have a tradition of making specially pickled sour vegetables.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Just from the description and the way it's made, it's similar to a Liyue specialty Master once told me about. She said the miners at Blackcliff Forge really love it – what an interesting coincidence!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: When I go back, I'll bring along some Mondstadt dishes that keep well. Next time we go on a picnic with Qiqi, she can try them too.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: And of course, I'll prepare a special portion just for you! I've heard so many legendary stories about you here in Mondstadt — you probably know the traditional dishes inside out by now.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: So I'll put on my thinking cap and try combining Qingce Stir Fry with Mondstadt ingredients... just to give you a little surprise!

choices.text: I'll come play in a bit.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: No problem! We'll be here!
